## Circular to Licensed Corporations which were Exempt Persons under the former regime

## Compliance with the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules

This circular is to remind licensed corporations which were exempt persons under the former regime 1 of their obligations to comply with the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules ('the Rules') upon expiration of the 6-month transitional period provided under the Rules.    As  the  transitional  period  will  expire  soon,  the  licensed  corporations  concerned should make necessary arrangements to ensure that they will fully comply with the Rules as from 1 October 2003 .

In  essence,  the  Rules  provide  for  the  financial  resources  requirements  applicable  to  all licensed corporations.  Such requirements include maintenance of the requisite paid-up share capital and liquid capital, submission of periodic financial resources returns to the SFC, etc.

Please  note  that  amongst  these  requirements,  section  56  of  the  Rules  stipulates  that  a financial  resources  return  submitted  by  a  licensed  corporation  shall  be  signed  by  a responsible officer (who is approved under section 126(1) of the Securities and Futures Ordinance  ('SFO'))  or  another  officer  of  the  licensed  corporation  (who  is  approved under section 58(5)(e) of the Rules) .  In that regard, a deemed licensed corporation (which has been in the industry before the commencement of the SFO) should note that although the corporation  does  not  need  to  comply  with  the  new  requirements  regarding  appointment  of responsible officers before 1 April 2005 2 , it should still consider nominating an individual to apply for approval as its responsible officer earlier in light of the above requirement of the Rules.    This  may  be  a  desirable  course  of  action  as  the  corporation  will  need  to  seek

1 Including exempt dealers and exempt investment advisers (not being authorized financial institutions) under the repealed Securities Ordinance.  These exempt persons are deemed as licensed corporations pursuant to section 25(b) of Part 1 of Schedule 10 to the SFO.

2 Being part of the transitional arrangements provided under section 53(1)(a)(ii) of Part 1 of Schedule 10 to the SFO.

migration  into  the  new  regime  before  1  April  2005  and  the  appointment  of  responsible officers is inevitable for the purpose of migration. 3

Alternatively, a licensed corporation may appoint another officer (who is not a responsible officer) to become an approved signatory for submitting its financial resources returns.  This arrangement will necessitate an application to be lodged by the licensed corporation under section  58(5)(e)  of  the  Rules  together  with  an  application  fee  of  $6,000.    For  detailed application  procedures  and  approval  criteria,  please  refer  to  our  circular  of  4  July  2003  Officer for Signing Financial Resources Returns (other than Responsible Officer) .

As either application aforementioned will take time to process, the licensed corporations  concerned  should  take  immediate  action  to  get  prepared  well  before  1 October 2003.

Should you have any queries on the above, please contact your responsible Intermediaries Relationship Manager of the Licensing Department.
